name: Rashmi Jamil
source:
A nonbinary young adult who is easily startled, but not perpetually afraid and actually quite prone to starting arguments.

Rashmi is one of three playable protagonists in Entropic Float. They're rather cagey about their personal life, and seem intent on convincing everybody else that they're a flawless genius.
